newsitem.title: NORWAY: SAGA SAYS N.SEA SNORRE OIL OUTPUT NORMAL.
newsitem.headline: SAGA SAYS N.SEA SNORRE OIL OUTPUT NORMAL.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday oil output at the North Sea Snorre oilfield was normal after a brief stoppage due to a problem in the production system.
Snorre resumed oil production at 9.50 a.m. (0750 GMT) on Tueaday, having been shut in since 4.20 a.m. (0220 GMT) on Monday.
"Everything is normal at Snorre, production is around 200,000 barrels per day," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag said.

Snorre suffered a five-day unscheduled outage in July after a short circuit caused a power blackout and subsequent problems with the auxilliary generating system. Both systems must before functioning before oil production is permitted to restart.
